deviations.item: Mysa key ring orientation (EXPERIENCE §4.2: ring axis along local X, key along local X)
deviations.change: The ring, its stand and the key turn together 35 degrees about the stand's vertical axis, the bow toward the camera. Sizes, the ring center and the stand are unchanged; the key still runs along the ring's axis.
deviations.why: From the stop camera (local +Z) a ring with its axis on X is edge-on: the first capture showed a brass cross, not a key passing through a ring (checklist box 4).

deviations.item: Mysa dial segments as four meshes, not instances
deviations.change: Four meshes sharing one TorusGeometry shape, each with its own accentGlow clone.
deviations.why: Each segment animates its own emissiveIntensity; an InstancedMesh shares one material and instanceColor does not reach emissive.

deviations.item: Mysa slab, Wailo phone and tag radii
deviations.change: Built as extruded rounded rectangles (corner radius as specified, small rounded edges) with creased normals, not drei RoundedBox.
deviations.why: drei RoundedBox needs radius <= depth / 2; the slab (0.03 on 0.05) and the phone (0.025 on 0.022) exceed it.

deviations.change: Same center in the face plane, z -0.051 instead of -0.043, so it sits on the face.
deviations.why: At the dial's z the 4 mm tube floats 8 mm off the slab.
Tilted 20 degrees, a center at 0.07 sinks its front edge 6 mm into the tray; 0.076 seats it on the tray top.

deviations.change: The tag leans back 15 degrees on the stand's front edge, its bottom on the tray; the 0.048 chain runs from the phone's right side, 3 cm above the lower right corner, to the tag top.
deviations.why: The phone's lower right corner is about 2.5 cm above the tray inside the stand, so a 5 cm chain cannot hang a 3.5 cm tag straight down without passing through the stand and tray.
EXPERIENCE §4.3 says only "arc at rest glow"; 0.5 makes the arc read as glowing (checklist box 1) while the 1.4 pulse and the 1.6 bar flash still stand out. The library rest level 0.15 was not tried.
